wars.name: Jat conquests under Suraj Mal
wars.outcome: Suraj Mal took Agra (12 June 1761) and the districts about it and Delhi; the Jat state reached its highest extent in his reign.

wars.name: Siege of Bharatpur (1805)
wars.outcome: Jat-Maratha defensive victory: four assaults failed; Ranjit Singh paid an indemnity and kept all his possessions including Deeg.

wars.name: Siege of Bharatpur (1825-1826)
wars.outcome: British victory: the fortress was stormed on 18 January 1826 and Balwant Singh confirmed; the page names no cession.

certainty.note: The pages give districts, forts and sieges but no boundary at any date; the extent after 1774 is not described.
